notes.title: Update notes for April 8 2024
notes.notes: Fixes and Memory Optimizations coinciding with the release of Volume 4

notes.title: The first patch is here
notes.notes:
Hey shmupers! We've just released a new patch for Hellfire. Details below:

* Default version on first run is 1P newer instead of 1P older
* Keyboard layout saves and loads properly again
* Keyboard icons displayed when using keyboard and in keyboard setup
* Record and replay reworked, replays from previous versions still works and should be better
* Stairstep screen mode bleeding in from right edge fixed
